perspective:
SEEKER’s available information:

- SEEKER asked for good new science fiction films, preferably already on DVD to buy or rent/watch online.
- SEEKER heard a recommendation for **Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015)** and indicated they had already seen it.
- SEEKER heard about **Passengers (2016)** with Jennifer Lawrence and Chris Pratt. The premise given: Pratt’s character is awakened prematurely on an interstellar space trip, then wakes Lawrence’s character for company; meanwhile the ship is in danger of falling apart and they must figure out why.
- SEEKER responded that **Passengers** sounded melodramatic. The recommender agreed it is melodramatic but called it still okay.
- SEEKER heard about **Life (2017)** with Jake Gyllenhaal and Ryan Reynolds. It was described as a dark film about an alien life form from Mars.
- SEEKER said that sounded more their speed.
- SEEKER heard about **The Thing (2011)**. The recommender told them it is not a remake of the original but a prequel, telling what happened to the Norwegians before the dog shows up at the US camp.
- SEEKER said they had never watched **The Thing** because they thought it was a remake. The recommender said it is entirely different story.
- SEEKER heard about **Pandorum (2009)** with Dennis Quaid and Ben Foster. It was described as very similar to **Passengers** but much darker and with no romance.
- SEEKER said they would check the films out and asked if they are all on DVD. The recommender told them, “Sure are,” so SEEKER has been told all the recommended films are on DVD.

SEEKER’s own actions/states in this interaction: asking for recommendations, having seen **Star Wars: The Force Awakens**, not having seen **Passengers**, finding **Passengers** melodramatic-sounding, preferring the **Life** description, having avoided **The Thing** because they thought it was a remake, planning to check out the recommendations, and asking about DVD availability.
